name: Finta
summary: Finance data platform that syncs bank transactions into tools like Notion, Airtable and Google Sheets, with AI categorization plus API and MCP access.
description: Finance data platform that syncs bank transactions into tools like Notion, Airtable and Google Sheets, with AI categorization plus API and MCP access.

pricing.details: 7-day free trial, no credit card, cancel anytime. A Monthly / Yearly “Save 17%” toggle is present. Standard 5 €/month billed 63 € annually — connect up to 10 banks, sync to unlimited workspaces, all data types, AI categorization, MCP and developer API. Business Pro 11 €/month billed 136 € annually — everything in Standard plus unlimited bank connections, higher API and MCP rate limits, priority support. The page title also says plans “from” a monthly amount.
